question: By what traditional name and lineage association is the Viṣṇu pool known?
premises: The site is called the Viṣṇu pool.
It is associated with the lineage of Dhanvantari.
This identification is declared as heard in tradition.
inference: Tradition identifies the Viṣṇu pool as belonging to the Dhanvantari lineage.
uncertainties: The precise scope of yāvad in relation to kulaṃ is ambiguous.
plain_english: It is heard in tradition that the Viṣṇu pool belongs to the lineage of Dhanvantari.
